question: The value of frac{{sqrt {768} times sqrt {3267} }}{{sqrt {144} }} is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine the **square roots** in the numerator and simplify by dividing the common factors.

√768 × √3267 / √144 ⇒ √(768 × 3267) / 12

⇒ √(256 × 3 × 1089 × 3) / 12 ⇒ (16 × 3 × 33) / 12

⇒ 4 × 33 = 132

**∴ The correct answer is 132.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** frac{{sqrt {768} times sqrt {3267} }}{{sqrt {144} }}

**Formula Used:** √(a × b) = √a × √b and √n² = n

⇒ Step 1: Factorize the numbers inside the **square root**.

⇒ 768 = 256 × 3 = 16² × 3

⇒ 3267 = 1089 × 3 = 33² × 3

⇒ 144 = 12²

⇒ Step 2: Substitute back into the **expression**.

⇒ (16√3 × 33√3) / 12

⇒ (16 × 33 × (√3 × √3)) / 12

⇒ (16 × 33 × 3) / 12

⇒ (16 × 99) / 12

⇒ (4 × 99) / 3

⇒ 4 × 33 = 132

**∴ The correct answer is 132.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Surds

For any positive real numbers a and b: √a × √b = √(ab) and √a / √b = √(a/b).

Perfect Squares

It is helpful to memorize squares up to 40 for **simplification**; e.g., 33² = 1089 and 12² = 144.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the order: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.</p
